Record and edit a motion and sound gesture

Contact sheet
Reproduce
Run the recorded-gesture browser check from examples/motion-envelope as described in its README.

Record a two-second gesture, edit its height curve and replay it as motion and sound.

Screenshots show recorded states. They do not establish latency, scientific accuracy, physical IME, screen-reader behavior, or human usability.
